description: This file provides utility functions for error normalization, string conversion, and logging HTTP errors within an API context. It helps ensure consistent logging and error handling in network requests, particularly those made with axios.

methods.name: toSafeString(value, fallback = '')
methods.description: Converts any value into a concise string suitable for logs, avoiding '[object Object]'.

methods.name: normalizeAxiosError(error, requestConfig)
methods.description: Processes axios error objects into a standardized shape extracting HTTP status, message, data, method, URL, and code.

methods.name: logHttpError(prefix, normalized)
methods.description: Logs structured information about an HTTP error, including response status, method, URL, message, and data for debugging.
